mascarilla-quirurgica.shortDescription: Surgical face masks for healthcare protection. CE marked.
mascarilla-quirurgica.description: Type II surgical masks for healthcare and pharmacy distribution. Individually packed boxes available for B2B orders.

mascarilla-ffp2.shortDescription: FFP-2 respirator masks with high filtration efficiency. CE marked.
mascarilla-ffp2.description: FFP-2 filtering facepiece respirators for professional use. Available for hospital and wholesale distribution.

nadal-covid-ag.shortDescription: COVID-19 antigen test. Lateral flow immunoassay. Kit of 20 tests.
nadal-covid-ag.description: NADAL COVID-19 Ag is a lateral flow chromatographic immunoassay for qualitative detection of SARS-CoV-2 nucleoprotein antigens in human nasopharyngeal and oropharyngeal samples.

nadal-covid-igg-igm.shortDescription: COVID-19 serology test. IgG and IgM detection. Kit of 10 tests.
nadal-covid-igg-igm.description: NADAL COVID-19 IgG/IgM is a lateral flow immunoassay for qualitative detection of anti-SARS-CoV-2 IgG and IgM in whole blood, serum or plasma.
